description: Avatar-overflow shrink branch. reduction was 1.0 across all 267 panels of cases 001-013, so the sumWidth > m_unitWidth branch (panel.cpp:784) had no golden. Two things blocked it: panelsWide only sets panels-per-row in the harness (the narrowing path CPageView::SetPanelsWide needs a window), and shrinking width and height together is self-defeating, since bodies scale to maxBodyHeight = m_unitHeight/1.9 (panel.cpp:755) and their widths scale with it - a square 2300 panel still reported 1.0. So this case keeps the height at 4860 and narrows only the width to MINUNITPANELWIDTH (2300), putting full-height bodies in a narrow frame, with four distinct speakers sharing the panel.
